nodes.text: From China’s initial chaos to UK hospitals now being overwhelmed, HMPV is the latest reminder of how quickly these viruses can spread when proper controls aren’t in place. 2/3

nodes.author: ahmadrasheed2m
nodes.text: When will the world start holding China accountable for the viruses they let loose? China should be formally named as a country of Virus! 3/3
